name: system development

name: anatomical structure formation involved in morphogenesis

Anatomical structures can be macroscopic such as a carpel, or microscopic such as an acrosome." [GOC:dph, GOC:jid, GOC:tb]

name: oculomotor nerve formation

This nerve also innervates the striated muscles of the eyelid. Pupillary constriction and lens movement are mediated by this nerve for near vision. In the orbit the inferior division sends branches that enter the ciliary ganglion where they form functional contacts (synapses) with the ganglion cells. The ganglion cells send nerve fibers into the back of the eye where they travel to ultimately innervate the ciliary muscle and the constrictor pupillae muscle." [GO_REF:0000021, GOC:cls, GOC:dgh, GOC:dph, GOC:jid, ISBN:0838580343]

name: olfactory placode development

name: replicative senescence

name: pancreatic stellate cell proliferation

name: oogenesis

name: vasculogenesis

name: alpha-beta T cell differentiation

They include glucocorticoids and mineralocorticoids." [GOC:mah, PMID:11027914]

name: regulation of cell cycle

name: detection of external stimulus
